THE WISDOM VAULT

Knowledge to carry
into life.

Fourteen foundational resources across three learning tracks, created by Collins Angel Ross and Eric Richson Darko to make practical relationship wisdom accessible beyond the classroom.

THE RESOURCE ENGINE

Ideas worth returning to.

Our publications are designed to support counseling curricula, digital learning and quiet study at home. Each book distills years of pastoral and counseling experience into practical, biblically grounded wisdom you can return to again and again. Explore the tracks below to find the subjects most relevant to your season.

Each title below is written by Collins Angel Ross or Eric Richson Darko and available to purchase through our Selar store. Tap a book to buy, or request a sample chapter.
